newsitem.title: UK: UK stocks weaken as rate, currency woes weigh.
newsitem.headline: UK stocks weaken as rate, currency woes weigh.

text.p: UK shares ushered in the new month with a 0.5 percent drop as investors fretted over the strength in sterling and rising interest rates, yet many traders and strategists said they still hold out hope for a year end rally.

The FTSE 100 index of leading stocks ended 19.5 points lower at 4,038.5, as decliners beat advancers by a margin of about two to one. Second-liners fared a little better. The FTSE 250 lost 13.7 points to settle at 4,414.8. Volume was thin, with only 463.1 million shares recorded by 1636 GMT.
